spec_match.rationale: Models add()'s contract exactly: a batch of rooted install paths, a SubAppsAddResponse split into installedApps (path→ManifestId) and failedApps (path→DOMException), the per-app failure taxonomy (ConstraintError/DataError/InvalidStateError/OperationError), and the batch-level rejection set including TypeError for non-rooted paths.

interactive.rationale: An editable multi-line path batch (deliberately seeded with a duplicate and a non-rooted path), a real add() call button, a reset, and paired installed/failed result tables.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises building a batch, calling the real add(), mapping installedApps/failedApps path-by-path, and the DOMException taxonomy; all present.

edge_cases.rationale: Client-side validation mirrors the spec's TypeError for non-rooted paths before calling, the absent-binding branch prints the exact payload that would be sent without pretending an install happened, and whole-batch rejections are reported with the real exception.

references.rationale: See-also cites https://chromestatus.com/feature/6260680824061952, the explainer's add() section, and the official sample demo.

conformance.rationale: The suite's subapps-add-method and add-rejects-non-rooted-path assertions encode this page's contract; their failure in this plain-origin Chromium 141 is the expected absent IWA-only binding.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 CLI/CDP (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud session): initial DOM shows the seeded sample batch and honest instructions; zero console errors, no unintended failed requests; the add/reset buttons and validation flow could not be driven non-interactively.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts path-validation catches, the unsupported branch with batch size, resolved responses with counts, and batch rejections with the exception name.

design_system.rationale: Tokenised colours; emerald and rose appear only as table border colours (≥3:1 non-text requirement met), the amber note is border-only, and the secondary button overrides background and color together.

accessibility.rationale: The textarea has a real label, results land in an aria-live output element, both tables carry captions with scoped headers, and the reference shape is textually labelled as not live.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: CDP-emulated 360×740 DPR3 measures 0px horizontal overflow and the batch textarea's live geometry (width 335.7px, right edge 343.7px) fits the 360px viewport with margin despite its min-width:20rem; desktop 1280×800 clean; only the environmental Google Fonts request fails.

openQuestions.title: Exercise a real partially-successful add() inside an IWA
openQuestions.detail: The installedApps/failedApps tables and the per-path DOMException mapping have only been verified against the reference shape, since add() cannot exist on this origin. Inside a flagged IWA (see the linked subapps-demo README), submit the seeded batch — duplicate included — and record the real partial response, confirming InvalidStateError for the duplicate and the ManifestId mapping for successes.

summary: A thorough contract page for subApps.add(): real call wiring, spec-faithful validation, a complete failure taxonomy, and an honest absent-binding branch that shows the exact would-be payload. Verified with headless Chromium 141 via CLI/CDP (chrome-devtools-mcp unavailable in this environment): clean render and console, no unintended failed requests, no overflow on either class with the textarea geometry confirmed to fit the 360px viewport. Remaining item: an in-IWA partial-response capture.
